lines: Ah, truly, what a wonderful world
And today again I'm lost in my own ugliness
And yet the feeling of loving someone
Is the one thing I have in full, so I writhe
Ugly, honestly, my face
Looks like God drew it with his left hand
Necessarily, not one love song in this world
Is absolutely meant for someone like me
A kiss with no use, taking pity just as it is
I shield myself with sequined scabs
I'm just not loved, that's all
Glaring bright, I swallow the night
Rap-tap-tap-tap
Just watch me, this Love
Stinging my eyes, 1mg of fireworks
Drag on, Drag on
How funny, this world is bizarre
Gira, gira-gira, gira
Unknown, before even Buddha knew it
I'd apparently gone soundly mad
Is it the world that's mad, or is it me?
Living together was impossible from the start
Sorrowful that we are counterfeits, we race headlong, race on
Before the strong acid rain washes it away
Holding a fluorescent-colored bruise
Blazing, spitting fire, I am the wolf of night
Rap-tap-tap-tap
Watch me there, this wild dance
Be strong, with your own kind of makeup
Flap up, Flap up
Suddenly, into anxiety
Loneliness is gasoline, I go through a servile town
Eyes closed — ready yet? Ready yet?
If God were left-handed, who knows how happy I might be
Glaring bright, I swallow the night
Rap-tap-tap-tap
Just watch me, this Love
Stinging my eyes, 1mg of fireworks
Drag on, Drag on
How funny, this world is bizarre
Gira, gira-gira, gira, gira-gira
Give love, the flowers brim over (glaring bright)
No one can stay as they are, not anyone
What a wonderful world!
Let's blaze bright
